partners.mechanism_chain: HSD17B4 (HGNC:5213) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009060); HSD17B4 (HGNC:5213) —DISRUPTS→ Bile acid synthesis (REACT:R-HSA-1901940); Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009060) —LEADS_TO→ Ovarian failure (HP:0008693); Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009060) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebellar ataxia (HP:0001251); Bile acid synthesis (REACT:R-HSA-1901940) —LEADS_TO→ Hepatomegaly (HP:0002293). Mutations in HSD17B4 disrupt both peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation and bile acid synthesis. Defects in fatty acid oxidation can lead to the accumulation of very long-chain fatty acids, impacting neuronal development and function, contributing to cerebellar ataxia. Impaired bile acid synthesis can lead to hepatomegaly. Ovarian failure, a hallmark of Perrault syndrome, is also linked to the broader metabolic dysfunction stemming from HSD17B4 deficiency.

partners.mechanism_chain: HSD17B4 (HGNC:4925) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisomal lipid metabolism (GO:0008202); Peroxisomal lipid metabolism (GO:0008202) —LEADS_TO→ Ovarian dysgenesis (HP:0030749); SCP2 (HGNC:10494) —DISRUPTS→ Cholesterol transport (GO:0046974); Cholesterol transport (GO:0046974) —LEADS_TO→ Ichthyosis (HP:0001031). Mutations in HSD17B4 disrupt peroxisomal lipid metabolism, leading to ovarian dysgenesis in Perrault syndrome 1. Separately, mutations in SCP2 disrupt cholesterol transport, contributing to ichthyosis in sterol carrier protein 2 deficiency. While the genes are distinct, both are involved in cellular lipid handling within distinct cellular compartments (peroxisomes for HSD17B4, and broader cellular transport for SCP2), suggesting a shared downstream impact on cellular homeostasis that could manifest phenotypically.

falsification.text: If genetic analysis reveals that loss-of-function mutations in HSD17B4 do not impair peroxisomal lipid metabolism or that loss-of-function mutations in SCP2 do not affect cholesterol transport, this hypothesis would be falsified. partners.mechanism_chain: HSD17B4 (HGNC:4977) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009074); Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009074) —LEADS_TO→ Ovarian dysgenesis (HP:0000078); Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009074) —LEADS_TO→ Hypogonadism (HP:0000827); AMACR (HGNC:497) —PRODUCES→ Branched-chain fatty acids (CHEBI:23831); Branched-chain fatty acids (CHEBI:23831) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009074); Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation (GO:0009074) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249).
